title: How a TV Works in Slow Motion - The Slow Mo Guys
summary: The Slow Mo Guys film a TV and screens with a high-speed camera to show how displays build an image. The footage includes CRT-style scanning and how pixels light up over time.
why: Frequently linked as visual proof of how a CRT's raster scan and phosphor decay work.

quote.text: This YouTube video by "The Slow Mo Guys" shows this in action
